name: Wand of Conducting

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Conducting
powers.text: 1 charge: it makes orchestral music. (No other effect in the game.)

text: Spend 1 of its 7 charges as a Magic action while holding it and orchestral music swells from the wand. It recovers 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn; spending the final charge means rolling 1d20, and a 1 reduces it to dust. (Purely flavour; it does nothing else in the game.)
